svg.title: A4 · V3 · Spoločné rozlúštenie
svg.desc: Generated illustrative families in the room and amber/blue atmosphere supplied by the owner; not customer photographs or testimonials. Approved small characters are integrated into the source photographs with natural lighting, interaction and occlusion behind people or furniture. The smaller phone sits closer to the family. Original game screenshot and physically cropped original worksheet previews are inserted in perspective and oriented toward the family, with editable typography. No full worksheets, QR, answers or access credentials embedded.
svg.text: Hľadajte a lúštite ako jeden tím.
